messages:
Lina: heads-up I'm going to run a preflight preview for `config.routing.entitlement_window` on staging in 20m. this is the new softened window intended to reduce oscillation across pools.
Marco: sounds good. clarify: preview only (no enforcement), right? we want to compute diffs and run invariants first.
Lina: correct, preview-only. runtime will evaluate new logic and emit a preview snapshot but not change active leases.
Yusuf: can we get the preview API to return a 202 + `preview_id` instead of 200? clients should poll for `propagation_eta_ms` and `affected_shards`. avoids accidental sync expectations.
Lina: yes I'll update the preview endpoint semantics. emergency fast-paths keep the current synchronous 200.
QA: test plan: 1) run preview against a 3% cohort 2) collect preview snapshots and current-state snapshots 3) run a delta job to compute entitlement drift + cost delta.
Yusuf: telemetry: avoid high-cardinality metrics. emit cohort-level aggregates `entitlement.preview_delta{cohort="c-17"}` and a sampled event stream `entitlement.preview_sampled` at 1/250 for tenant-level traces.
Marco: console needs a preflight panel that shows side-by-side aggregates (p50/p95 qps, denied_rate, avg_alloc) and a link "inspect sampled tenants" that opens a redacted trace list. ops asked for that after last rollout.
Lina: will add the panel. also adding a top-banner when preview is active with clear title "PREVIEW: not applied" and an explicit "Promote to apply" CTA that opens an ACK modal.
QA: ACK modal should show: preview_id, commit hash, who last edited config, preview snapshot diff (human bullets). reduce cognitive load for approvers.
Yusuf: audit: store ack actor + preview_id + commit in the ledger and include a machine-readable `audit_token` returned after ACK to use for later rollbacks.
Marco: runbook: auto-pause preview if `entitlement.preview_delta` > 2% absolute for any cohort OR if we see >5 sampled tenant incidents in 10m. ops-bot should create an incident draft with the preview snapshot attached.
Lina: proposing auto-pause threshold = 2% delta OR 3 sampled incidents in 15m. manual override only with a 2-person ack recorded in the ledger.
Yusuf: also add a boolean gauge per-shard `entitlement.preview_leak{shard="s-3"}` so SRE can alert without tenant cardinality. emit sampled tenant IDs to secure logs with 1/250 sampling.
QA: for replay, persist preview snapshots to S3 for 21 days and run a deterministic replay job that replays sampled input with both prev/new windows to compute CPU and token-cost delta. output should be a small CSV per preview_id for Optimize to consume.
Marco: API contract: preview apply returns 202 + preview_id. poll endpoint `/preview/{id}/status` returns {state, estimated_propagation_ms, affected_shards}. once state=ready UI fetches aggregates.
Lina: noted. I'll send two PRs: runtime telemetry + preview API semantics.
devops-bot: preview-created by lina/preflight-ent-window  diff: 6 files changed  http://ci.redwood/internal/7710
Yusuf: one UX ask: when preview is active, expose an export button that zips the preview snapshot + sampled traces + replay results and attaches to incident drafts so SRE can triage offline.
Lina: good idea. will add export and link it in the incident draft.
QA: schedule note: avoid running the replay during the nightly ingestion job window. queue it to run at T+2h.
Marco: thanks. tag me on the API PR and the console mock so I can sanity-check the affected_shards field formatting.
Lina: will do. launching preview at T+20.
